blocks.text: This page tracks the Pitt Meadows MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $848,800 for a typical home, down 3.6% over twelve months.
Pitt Meadows benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Pitt Meadows home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $848,800 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.1% on the month, little changed at −0.3% over three months, down 3.4% over six months and down 3.6% over the year. Over three years it is down 6.5%, and over five years up 7.4%.
The weakest one-year move in Pitt Meadows was for a townhouse homes at −8.7%; the strongest was an apartment at −2.4%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,178,600) and an apartment ($558,200) is $620,400, and a townhouse ($737,500) sits $179,300 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Pitt Meadows is 21.1% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 3.6% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Pitt Meadows ranks 17 by all-home benchmark, with Burnaby North above it at $877,100 and Port Coquitlam below it at $835,500.

Detached homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $1,178,600, little changed at −0.9% in a month, little changed at −0.8% in three months, down 5.1% in six months, down 2.8% in a year, down 10.5% in three years and up 1.8% in five. That is 34.0% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $737,500, little changed at −1.3% in a month, down 3.1% in three months, down 6.6% in six months, down 8.7% in a year, down 8.2% in three years and up 3.6% in five. That is 27.5% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Pitt Meadows: benchmark $558,200, up 2.1% in a month, up 2.9% in three months, little changed at −0.2% in six months, down 2.4% in a year, down 9.0% in three years and up 7.0% in five. That is 18.2% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the Pitt Meadows figure is
The $848,800 Pitt Meadows figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Pitt Meadows home was $848,800, with detached at $1,178,600.

faq.q: Are Pitt Meadows home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Pitt Meadows is down 3.6% over twelve months and little changed at −0.3% over three months.
